'''Joshua Jefferson''' (born November 21, 2003) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's Gaels]] and [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State Cyclones]].

==Early life and high school==
Jefferson attended [[Liberty High School (Nevada)|Liberty High School]] in [[Henderson, Nevada]]. As a [[Senior (education)|senior]], he averaged 17.7 points, ten rebounds, four assists, and two steals per game and helped lead his team to a Class 5A state championship.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Orts |first1=Jason |title=Nevada Preps Boys Athlete of the Year: Liberty’s Joshua Jefferson |url=https://www.reviewjournal.com/nevada-preps/schools/liberty/nevada-preps-boys-athlete-of-the-year-libertys-joshua-jefferson-2596014/ |website=Las Vegas Review-Journal |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> Jefferson committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's Gaels]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Graney |first1=Ed |title=Saint Mary’s-bound Joshua Jefferson dreams big |url=https://www.reviewjournal.com/sports/sports-columns/ed-graney/graney-saint-marys-bound-joshua-jefferson-dreams-big-2545914/ |website=Las Vegas Review-Journal |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref>

==College career==
=== Saint Mary's ===
As a [[freshman]] in 2022–23, Jefferson averaged 2.2 points and 1.4 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sayfie |first1=Clayton |title=Michigan basketball targeting Saint Mary's transfer Joshua Jefferson |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/michigan-wolverines/news/michigan-wolverines-basketball-targeting-saint-marys-transfer-joshua-jefferson/ |website=On3.com |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> In 2023-24, he averaged 10.2 points, 6.5 rebounds, and 2.3 assists per game. After the season, Jefferson entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Graham |first1=Chris |title=Transfer target Joshua Jefferson thinks he can ‘speed up’ Virginia’s tempo |url=https://augustafreepress.com/news/transfer-target-joshua-jefferson-thinks-he-can-speed-up-virginias-tempo/ |website=Augusta Free Press |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref>

=== Iowa State ===
Jefferson transferred to play for the [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State Cyclones]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gray |first1=Rob |title=ISU men’s basketball star Joshua Jefferson broke with family tradition |url=https://www.thegazette.com/cyclone-basketball/isu-mens-basketball-star-joshua-jefferson-broke-with-family-tradition/ |website=The Gazette |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> In the first round of the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], he tallied ten points, eight rebounds, eight assists, three steals, and two blocks in a victory against [[2024–25 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Lipscomb]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hines |first1=Travis |title=Mr. Do It All Joshua Jefferson thriving for Iowa State basketball in March Madness |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/iowa-state/basketball-mens/2025/03/23/iowa-state-basketball-joshua-jefferson-cyclones-march-madness-ole-miss-ncaa-tournament/82624140007/ |website=The Des Moines Register |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> He finished the 2024–25 season averaging 13 points, 7.4 rebounds, 3.1 assists, and 2.1 steals per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hines |first1=Travis |title=Iowa State basketball hoping for Joshua Jefferson to become The Punisher |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/iowa-state/basketball-mens/2025/10/08/iowa-state-basketball-joshua-jefferson-media-day-cyclones/86547768007/ |website=The Des Moines Register |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> Jefferson decided to return to the Cyclones for the 2025-26 season.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hines |first1=Travis |title=Iowa State basketball forward Joshua Jefferson dealing with wrist sprain |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/iowa-state/basketball-mens/2025/07/15/iowa-state-basketball-joshua-jefferson-injury-update-cyclones/85209848007/ |website=The Des Moines Register |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> On December 11, 2025, he recorded 24 points in a comeback win over rival [[2025–26 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=White |first1=Zander |title=Joshua Jefferson leads No. 4 Iowa State back from 13-point deficit in win over Iowa |url=https://who13.com/news/joshua-jefferson-leads-no-4-iowa-state-back-from-13-point-deficit-in-win-over-iowa/ |website=WHO13.com |access-date=11 January 2026}}</ref> On January 2, 2026, Jefferson notched ten points, ten rebounds, and ten assists in a victory over [[2025–26 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gray |first1=Rob |title=Joshua Jefferson's triple-double helps No. 3 Iowa State handle West Virginia, 80-59 January 20th, 2026, Jefferson had 17 points, 12 assists, and 10 rebounds.
